newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia soldier faces death penalty for shooting.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia soldier faces death penalty for shooting.

text.p: Indonesian military prosecutors have demanded the death sentence for a special forces soldier accused of killing 16 people during a one-man shooting spree last year, the official Antara news agency reported on Tuesday.
Military prosecutor Colonel Balukia on Monday demanded the death penalty for Second Lieutenant Sumorip, who is accused of shooting 26 people, both military officers and civilians.
Court officials have said Sumorip of the Kopassus elite forces killed 16 people at the airport in Timika town in remote Irian Jaya province last April.

The dead included Sumorip's commanding officer and three fellow Kopassus soldiers. Other soldiers and four civilians, including a New Zealand pilot working in Irian Jaya, were also killed in the two-hour shooting spree, newspapers reported at the time. Ten people were injured.
Military prosecutors have said Sumorip may have been spurred to violence over frustration with his assignments.
Under Indonesian court procedures, Sumorip was not required to enter a plea in the case, which is continuing.
